chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Fayḍ asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, saying:
“May I have intercourse while I am naked?” He said: “No, and do not face the qiblah, nor turn your back to it.”

key_terms.تَسْتَدْبِرُهَا: you turn your back toward it

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to have intercourse while naked or facing the qiblah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the etiquette of marital intercourse. It prohibits intercourse while completely naked and also forbids facing the qiblah or turning one’s back toward it during the act.
